name: fast-mesh-wasm
description: Fast triangle mesh utilities for JavaScript, written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly
author: DongGeun Yoon

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (['dist/wasm/fast_mesh_wasm.d.ts', 'dist/wasm-threads/fast_mesh_wasm.d.ts'].some((f) => require('fs').existsSync(f) && require('fs').readFileSync(f, 'utf8').includes('__test_'))) { console.error('dist/ is a test build (it exports __test_ hooks): run pnpm build first'); process.exit(1); } if (!require('fs').existsSync('dist/wasm-threads/fast_mesh_wasm_bg.wasm')) { console.error('dist/ has no threaded artifact (dist/wasm-threads): run pnpm build first'); process.exit(1); } const fs = require('fs'); const walk = (d) => fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((e) => e.isDirectory() ? walk(d + '/' + e.name) : [d + '/' + e.name]); const helpers = walk('dist/wasm-threads/snippets').filter((f) => f.endsWith('/workerHelpers.js')); if (helpers.length !== 1 || helpers.some((f) => /import\(.\.\.\/\.\.\/\.\..\)/.test(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')))) { console.error('dist/wasm-threads has no rayon worker helper, or it still imports the glue as a directory (../../..): run pnpm build first'); process.exit(1); }"
